# Drafter notes — hammurabi-laws-42-51 (§42–51, Col. XII 63 – XIV 66)

25 units, 144 stele lines, XII 63–67, XIII 1–73, XIV 1–66 in order. Plates XIX (PDF 253), XX (255), XXI (257), XXII (259) read line by line in crops; Harper’s List of Signs consulted (PDF 385, 391, 409).

## Logograms identified (plate evidence)
- **A.ŠÀ = eqlum** (Harper eḳlam/eḳlim/eḳil/eḳli-): two signs A + ŠÀ on every occurrence. XIII 6 shows A.ŠÀ followed by -am (Harper eḳla-am), kept as phonetic complement `A.ŠÀ-am`. XIV 35, 52 eḳli-ma = `A.ŠÀ-ma`. Construct eqel (XIV 21, 47) and eqlišu/eqelšu read from context on the same A.ŠÀ-šu spelling.
- **ŠE = šeʾum** (šeʾam / šeʾim / šeʾum XIV 8): the single ŠE sign, no complement.
- **ŠE.GIŠ.Ì = šamaššammū** (Harper šamaššammam/-im; his glossary “[ŠE.IZ.NI]”): three signs ŠE, GIŠ, NI(=Ì) on XIV 22, 25, 31, 33, 47, 49, 59. tr written ŠE.GIŠ.Ì (modern); Harper’s ŠE.IZ.NI noted in the gloss.
- **KÙ.BABBAR = kaspum** (XIV 19, 37, 54, 56, 61), KÙ.BABBAR-šu at 37, 61.
- **DAM.GÀR = tamkārum** (XIV 19, 23, 39, 43, 55, 63, 66) — the plate has the DAM-sign + GÀR, as §40.
- **GÚN = biltum** (XIII 36 biltim, 39 and 47 bilat): single GUN sign, as §37.
- **{d}IM = Adad** (XIII 42, XIV 3): AN determinative + IM.
- **KI.KAL** (XIII 18): KI + KAL on the plate; Harper’s sign list (no. 177, PDF 409) gives KI.KAL; his glossary “KI.KAL, KANKAL, nidûtu”. Akkadian value given as nidûtum (fallow). Harper prints a full stop after KI.KAL — not carried over.
- **MU 3{kam}** (XIII 19, Harper šattim III{kam}): year-sign MU, three verticals, KAM — same writing as §30. say “šalaš šanātim” is a reconstruction of the spoken count (marked “(?)” in the gloss); review whether the house prefers a different spoken form (the model’s §30 used “šattam šalaštam” for the ordinal).
- **10 GAN₂.E** (XIII 32): corner-wedge + GAN₂ + E. Harper GAN.E; his Index “GAN = 1,800 SAR = 6.67 acres”. Akkadian value given as būrum (modern equation of the unit); flag for reviewer — this is an identification of the measure, not a reading Harper gives.
- **10 ŠE.GUR** (XIII 33): corner-wedge + ŠE + GUR. val “kur šeʾam” is a convenience; the spoken form of grain measures is conventional.
- **BURU₁₄ = ebūrum** (XIII 68, XIV 33, Harper ebûrim): a single compound sign; matches Harper’s sign list no. 19 “ebûru” (PDF 385). New sign BURU14 (EN×GAN₂-tenû).
- **KA = pûm** (XIV 64, Harper pî): single KA sign; Harper’s sign list no. 12 “ka, pû”.

## Syllable signs to check
- XIII 57 i-zu-uz-zu: the uz is the goat-sign → new key UZ3.
- XIII 28 i-mar-ra-ar: MAR → new key MAR.
- XIII 65 u-up-pa-as: final sign read AZ (Harper list no. 63 “az, aṣ”), tr “as” as Harper prints.
- XIII 22 a-aḫ-šu: AḪ sign.
- u “and” rendered ù (U3) throughout, as the model part does; Harper prints plain u.

## Harper’s apparatus points
- **XIII 62 il-lu(=ḳu)-u**: carver’s slip LU for QU kept, Harper’s correction in tr `lu(=ḳu)` and in the note. The faint mark over the u of il-lu in the transcription apparatus is ignored (a speck).
- **XIV 11 ḫu-bu-ul-[li]**: [li] is Harper’s restoration; kept bracketed in tr, said in the note.
- **XIV 63 il-ku-u vs XIV 40 il-ḳu-u**: written il-ḳu-u here (ilqû). Both lines on the plate show the same KU sign (ku/qu), so the k/ḳ difference is Harper’s printing, not the stone. Note says so. Reviewer: confirm on Plate XXII.
- XIII 6: possible acute over ma of šum-ma — no reflection on the plate (normal MA). Read šum-ma.
- XIII 65/66 plain s in u-up-pa-as, ir-ri-su-ma: kept as printed. ir-ri-su-ma read irrissuma (irrišum + -šu, š+š → ss).
- XIV 4 ir-ta-ḫi-iṣ: the speck under t ignored; plate shows TA.

## Readings where Harper is superseded or uncertain (said in notes)
- bibbulum (XIII 43, XIV 5): Harper “produce”; later lexicography “flood”. Rendered as a flood, both stated.
- mayyārum (XIII 12, 26): Harper “hoe”; later “plough”. Rendered “plough”, both stated.
- apšitûm (XIII 56): Harper’s own “(?)”; rendered “agreed proportion” from context, flagged.
- uppas (XIII 65): Harper’s apāsum D “to interfere”; meaning uncertain, flagged.
- eqlam erēšam iqtabi (XIII 63): read as subletting (Harper’s sense); the compression is noted.
- ṣimdatum (XIV 64): Harper “scale”; rendered “ordinance/schedule”.

## Units and splits
§42 (2 units), §43 (2), §44 (3), §45 (2), §46 (2), §47 (3), §48 (3), §49 (5), §50 (2), §51 (2). Units 1 of §48 ends at XIII 73 and the next begins at XIV 2 so that “i-ba-aš-ši-ma” (XIV 1) stays with the protasis: §48’s first unit runs XIII 71 – XIV 1 across the column change.

## Candidate house renderings
- bēl eqlim “the owner of the field”; irrišum “the tenant” (in §49 “the cultivator”).
- bēl ḫubullim “the creditor”; ṭuppašu uraṭṭab “he shall soak his tablet” (literal, with the note explaining rewriting).
- ana pî ṣimdat šarrim “according to the king’s schedule”.
- {d}IM irtaḫiṣ “the storm-god Adad flooded”.
- mānaḫtum “upkeep / cost (of cultivation)”.
